svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the flat blank from the tray blank picture: 165 x 98 mm with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 x 55 mm tab on one long edge, 5 mm from the charging end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold lines 10 mm in from each long edge. On the tab side, cut the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm strip away from the charging end to 48 mm (beside the tab).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window for the camera bump: 34 x 34 mm, centred 25 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: charging end on the centre line. Measure your phone first: the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: window is the bump plus 2 mm all round, wherever the bump is.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 5.5 mm holes in the tab, on its centre line, 19 and 49 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold both strips up 90 degrees in a vice between hardwood blocks:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 78 mm inside between the lips for a 76 mm phone.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: tab flat under the arm end; the phone lies screen up, its bump

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the window. Check: the phone drops in and lifts out freely.
